name: arxa-workspace
description: Phase 1 of docs/plans/file-organisation-implementation.md — the raw on-disk tree format: workspace-root persistence (D36), org/project scaffolding with the five fixed categories (D42), kebab-case slugs with numeric-suffix collision handling (D41), org.json/project.json manifests where rename touches the manifest and never the slug (D41), thin AGENTS.md context-file placement (D43), and resolve-by-stable-id over the tree.
